notes.text: The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 10 games cover only 30% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the 6th-lowest in the league (a typical team: 38%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.

Igor Chernyshov is on injured reserve (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 17 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Ivar Stenberg has taken his spot beside Will Smith and Macklin Celebrini. That line has had 61% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 69:09 together, about what it had with Chernyshov (60%).
Kiefer Sherwood is on injured reserve and has missed the last 5 games.

Jacob Trouba is out (lower body injury) and has missed the last 3 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. Nolan Allan has taken his spot beside Sam Dickinson. That pair has had 66% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 38:18 together, up from 43% with Trouba.
Anthony Mantha is on long-term injured reserve (neck injury) and has missed the last 9 games.
Johnathan Kovacevic is on injured reserve (ankle injury) and has missed the last 7 games.

story.head: Penalties could cost the Sharks
paras: The Devils have won three straight, and the Sharks (12-14-2) beat Vegas 4-1 on Friday. Going in, the Sharks are third in the Pacific (tied for 19th in the NHL) and the Devils second in the Metropolitan (fifth).

The Sharks are one of the league’s most physical teams (3rd) and ice the puck a lot (32nd). The Devils, by contrast, rarely throw hits (2nd lowest). The Sharks also have a leaky penalty kill (31st), so the Devils’ power play (5th) could do real damage when they’re shorthanded. San Jose has scored 2.57 goals a game, the second fewest in the league. On the other side, the Devils draw more penalties than they take (3rd) and keep things calm after the whistle (3rd lowest). New Jersey has scored 3.73 goals a game, the fourth most in the league. Both teams like to play fast, so expect an open game.

Macklin Celebrini (11 G / 22 A / 33 P in 26 GP) leads the Sharks in scoring. Jack Hughes (11 G / 23 A / 34 P in 26 GP) leads the Devils in scoring and is tied for seventh in the NHL, with seven points in his last five games.
Yaroslav Askarov (7-10-1 / .893 SV% in 18 GS) will likely start for San Jose, and Connor Hellebuyck (9-1-0 / .900 SV% in 11 GS) for New Jersey.

At home, Sheldon Keefe likes to send Meier, Hughes and Brown out against opponents’ second lines, so watch for them against Marchment, Dellandrea and Smith. One more thing: the Devils usually control more of the chances than the Sharks do.

items.text: The Sharks are newly without Jacob Trouba, and have been without Igor Chernyshov and Kiefer Sherwood for several games.
The Devils have been without Anthony Mantha and Johnathan Kovacevic for several games.
Luke Evangelista has five goals in seven games against San Jose since 2023-24, most of them with Nashville.
Jack Hughes has eight goals on chances worth about 12.9 goals, well below what his finishing usually turns chances into. If the chances keep coming, so should the goals.
